content.d: Dabigatran is not recommended in patients with CrCl <30 mL/min. Edoxaban should be given at a dose of 30 mg once daily in patients with CrCl of 15–50 mL/min and is not recommended in patients with CrCl <15 mL/min. Rivaroxaban and apixaban are to be used with caution in patients with CrCl 15–29 mL/min, and their use is not recommended in patients with CrCl <15 mL/min.
